model: Conext Core XC Series grid-tie PV inverter (0G-XC-BB)
applies_to: Conext Core XC Series grid-tied PV inverters (540/630/680 kW ratings, 0G-XC-BB) with firmware v1.07 and later; some registers need newer firmware as noted.
summary: The Conext Core XC is a grid-tied three-phase PV inverter with an RS-485 Modbus RTU port. All values are 16-bit integers with a fixed multiplier, read with function 03 and written with function 16. This map covers the read-only monitoring block (0x1700-0x1828), ratings and grid-code settings, the main power-limit and remote enable/disable controls, Modbus port settings and the log-reading registers.

addressing.note: The application note says register addresses are zero based, printed in hex, and go straight into the request's address field. A master that wants register numbers must convert to decimal and add 1.

firmware: v1.07 and later (individual registers list a minimum firmware, e.g. v3.01, v5.00)

source.title: Conext Core XC Series, 0G-XC-BB Grid-Tied Photovoltaic Inverter: Using Modbus Application Note
source.pages: PDF pp. 4-15 (RS-485 settings, functions, scaling, state codes, logs), p. 15 (addressing), pp. 16-17 (Table 17 monitoring), pp. 19-27 (Table 18 writable), pp. 28-30 (read-only configuration)

notes: Scale: the document gives units as 'unit/xN', meaning divide the raw value by N; this is converted to scale = 1/N.

Left out: the 32-bit items (kWh Energy Produced 0x0802-0x0803, Energy Today 0x0804-0x0805, Operating Hours 0x081E-0x081F and Time 0xFA21-0xFA22) because the note does not state their word order; the text product designation, assembly and serial number blocks (0x1-0x1D, typed uchar8); and the log buffer registers.

Only a selection of the writable registers in Table 18 is included (enable/disable, power and phase-current limits, power reference source, MPPT voltage window, port settings and a few grid-support switches). The many grid-code thresholds and delays are left out.
Registers flagged ** in the note can be written while the inverter is enabled; the rest need the inverter disabled.
Unmapped addresses inside a block read 0xFFFF without an error; writing one returns an illegal address exception.
The note's Table 20/21 for the optional Vigilohm IM400 insulation monitor is a separate device and is not part of this map.

integration.summary: Poll 0x1700-0x1828 with function 03 for state, grid voltages and currents, active/reactive power and PV values (all 16-bit, divide by the listed factor). To control power, set Parameter Control Station (0xE0E0) to 2 = Modbus, then write the active power limit at 0xFA19 with function 16.
integration.enable: On the front panel go to 2 Language, Time, Interface > Comm. Interface > Parameter Control Station and select panel control to set the Modbus address and baud rate, then power-cycle with QF2. For writes, set register 0xE0E0 to 2 (Modbus).
quirks: Addresses are hex and zero based; a master that counts from 1 must add one.
Only function codes 03, 16, 08 (sub-function 00) and 43 are supported; there is no FC06 single-register write.
Changing the Modbus unit ID (0xE0E1 commit, 0x8003) needs a system reset before it takes effect.
setup: Default RS-485 settings: 19200 baud, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit; all inverters on one bus must use the same settings.
Do not use 57600 baud if the Vigilohm IM400 is installed (it only supports 38400).
gotchas: Reading an unmapped address returns 0xFFFF with no exception, so a wrong address can look like a valid value.
Leaving Logger Mode (0x4705) in any read mode stops data logging; set it back to 0.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
